text: Final categorization: REVIEW (Justification: The paper is explicitly labeled as a "Review article" and synthesizes global research on climate change impacts on wine production, including shifts in the geographic suitability of winegrowing regions. It discusses future projections of changing viticultural areas—effectively addressing land use/land cover (LULC) changes related to vineyard expansion or loss under climate scenarios. Although LULC prediction is not the sole focus, the review assesses future suitability maps (e.g., Fig. 1) and evaluates emerging and disappearing wine regions at global scale, which constitutes a synthesis of LULC-related future predictions. Therefore, it meets the criterion for 'REVIEW' as it touches on LULC future prediction through aggregated suitability modeling across regions.)
